name: evidence_limits
content: Isolated sequence XML lists the same SyncRun test incomplete and dump proves active oversized read. Preserved artifacts supplied do not contain launch/output for a second empty-shell-CWD run, its exact 20-second timeout, or a dump/log for the earlier seven-minute halted suite. scope: Read-only diagnosis of preserved full-suite and isolated dump evidence; no code or TODO/requirement state edited.

passes.evidence: Full log reports Blame 60-second inactivity abort after 2801 passed and 11 failed, not a green completion; full sequence XML has exactly one incomplete SyncRun test.
Independent dotnet-dump dumpasync/dumpobj confirms isolated test await chain through File.InternalReadAllTextAsync and RepoIngestor to the 206949577-byte SharpNinja.McpServer.QBAgent.1.4.35.nupkg.

Source fixture constructs real coordinator/RepoIngestor with RepoRoot dot, workspace context dot and null allowlist. RepoIngestor reads full text before enforcing 1MB MaxFileSizeBytes; directory enumeration includes the nupkg.

The dump shows an active asynchronous file read with partial content, so evidence supports oversized slow I/O and memory pressure under a timeout, not a demonstrated deadlock. Blame language host crashed follows its forced termination and does not independently show an application crash.

All 11 reported failed test names and messages were inspected separately: six migration Down, two DbFkContract, two MemoryTxn, one CliBrainSlotStrategy. They predate the inactivity abort and are not explained by RepoIngestor.

failures.evidence: BDPv4 full-suite green exit gate remains unmet: 11 failures plus aborted host, independently of the oversized binary read. Do not close increment A or mark FR/TR/TEST/TODO satisfied.

unknown.evidence: The isolated dump and sequence identify the test and active read, but preserved artifacts provided here do not prove two separate 20-second aborted runs from both repo and empty shell CWD; no saved command/output for that pair was found.

The earlier seven-minute suite stop has no matching dump/sequence in this review. Same fixture and binary make the mechanism plausible, but the current 60-second bounded run cannot establish the earlier run cause retrospectively.

decision: DISAGREE with any broad claim that all full-suite hangs are proved to be this cause or that the full-suite gate passed. The current bounded timeout is strongly explained by oversized binary ReadAllTextAsync before limit check. Remediate the ingestion/test fixture separately and investigate the eleven independent failures, then rerun the applicable suite and hostile gate.
